output.reason: [ev-7d2769e8c602] applies this to anyone who configured `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` "or its YAML setting", so a condition that only checks the CLI flag misses environments that set it in the YAML config. The same excerpt also says index access is lost only where the setting does not match `object_store` for periods using `boltdb-shipper`. Where the values match, the operator only has to remove the deleted option. No condition op can compare these two values per period, so the YAML usage and the mismatch are expressed as undecidable operands.

correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes -boltdb.shipper.shared-store and its YAML setting. Exposed: environments that set it as a CLI flag or in YAML to a value that differs from object_store for any boltdb-shipper period. For those periods the index can no longer be queried until the index tables are moved or copied to the object_store store.
